tools.name: agentmemory_searchMemories
tools.description: Hybrid FTS search across the agent's memories — tsvector + GIN ranking returns memories matching the query, ordered by confidence and FTS relevance. Filter by kind for focused results.

agent_id.description: The agent ID whose memories to search

query.description: Natural language search query (matches title + body via tsvector)

kinds.description: Filter by memory kind — decision, learning, pattern, preference, fact, summary. Omit for all kinds.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentmemory_recallRelevant
tools.description: Topic-aware recall using two-stage retrieval — FTS pre-filter (100 candidates) then an LLM reranker picks the most relevant. Better quality than raw searchMemories for fuzzy or conversational queries, but more expensive (one LLM call per recall).

agent_id.description: The agent ID whose memories to search

query.description: The topic, question, or conversation context to find relevant memories for. Full natural language works — the LLM reranker understands intent, not just keywords.

kinds.description: Filter by memory kind — decision, learning, pattern, preference, fact, summary

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentmemory_createMemory
tools.description: Persist a new memory deliberately. Use when you learn something that will be needed in a future session and isn't already in agentdocs or the agent's workspace files. Memories carry kind, title, body, confidence, importance, and optional tags.

agent_id.description: The agent ID to associate this memory with

kind.description: Memory kind — decision (choices made with rationale), learning (insight gained from experience), pattern (recurring observations — usually auto-consolidated from learnings), preference (stated user/team preferences), fact (objective info: URLs, IDs, version numbers).

title.description: Concise title (≤100 chars). Searchable; surfaces first in result lists.

body.description: Detailed description. No length cap, but compression kicks in for prose >50 tokens.

tags.description: Array of 1-5 tags for categorization. Tags enable auto-consolidation (3+ learnings with same tag → pattern).

confidence.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0. Decays ~2%/week unless `critical` importance or `summary` kind. Floor 0.1. Archived at <0.15 + age >30d.

importance.description: Importance level. `critical` is exempt from confidence decay. Critical = ops-blocking truth; high = often-needed; normal = default; low = rarely-needed.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)

tools.name: agentmemory_getStats
tools.description: Overview of the memory collection — total active count, breakdown by kind and importance, average confidence, and the count of archived memories. Lightweight introspection.

workspace.description: Workspace slug (optional; uses current workspace from ~/.opvs/config.json if omitted)
